source_route_reference: Reviewed R01–R14 proposal extended into finite synthetic guards

fault_route.from: Any step, including admission and closeout
sequence: Keep current accepted holder and resource lease
Record failed/interrupted/uncertain attempt and raw evidence
Request qualified containment or safe hold
Wait for independently observed safe state and support
Reconcile actual custody and service status
Archive or issue a new fully qualified attempt without overwriting failure
prohibited: Release based solely on command acknowledgement
Claiming completed experiment when branch or custody is pending

iteration_rule: Each experimental attempt has unique trial_id/attempt_id; remount/flip requires safe hold and new mount/calibration/coordinate evidence. No automatic physical retry.
